name: wow-addon-finder
description: Before you write a World of Warcraft addon, Claude looks for the ones that already do it: WoWInterface's whole catalog (names and folder names, then the descriptions of the closest ones) and CurseForge through a web search. It tells you what overlaps with your idea and what's left to build, and keeps the result in docs/prior-art/ in your project, where it looks first next time. It can also check that a folder name is free. Skill: find-similar, which starts on its own when you say you want to make an addon, or with /wow-addon-finder:find-similar <idea>.
